HOW IT WORKS

Three steps. Fully automated.

01

Patient calls your clinic

Inbound call, form fill, or ad inquiry -- any time, day or night. Your AI receptionist picks up instantly.

02

AI handles the conversation

Answers questions about procedures, providers, and insurance. Books the appointment directly into your calendar.

03

Patient is booked and confirmed

SMS and email confirmation sent. Reminder sequence activated. Synced to your EHR. Zero staff involvement.

FEATURES

Everything your front desk does. But better.
Instant Response

Every call answered in under 1 second. Patients hear back before they Google your competitor.

Smart Scheduling

Books into your real calendar with provider availability, service duration, and conflict detection built in.

Follow-up Sequences

7-day automated nurture via call, SMS, and email. Converts the leads that would otherwise ghost.

EHR Integration

Native sync with Practice Fusion, Dentrix, Nextech, ModMed, and more. Appointments land in your system of record.

HIPAA Compliant

End-to-end encryption, signed BAAs with every vendor. Built for healthcare from day one.

Real-time Analytics
